bootstrap.method: Paired-row resampling with replacement, retaining each baseline/candidate pair

target.criterion: Observed full-sample point estimate only; not a guarantee or generalization claim

common_label_macro_f1.definition: Both models use the same fixed observed human/baseline/candidate label union. Missing predictions are false negatives; absent and prediction-only classes contribute zero F1.

own_union_macro_f1_diagnostics.limits: Different label denominators; compare improvement using the common-label macro above.

limits: Opened historical benchmark, not a fresh holdout or prospective estimate.
Human-review independence and correctness retain the limitations recorded with the original reviews.
These results are produced after prediction and scoring; never feed them into candidate fitting, calibration, feature selection or dashboard accuracy.
